m: sainya mfn. belonging to or proceeding from an army, MBh.; Hariv.
sainya m. (ifc. f(ā). ) a soldier (pl. ‘troops’), R.
sainya m. an army, MBh.; Rājat.
sainya n. a body of troops, army, MBh.; R. &c.
a: sainyaḥ [senāyāṃ samavaiti ñya] 1 A soldier; Śi. 5. 28. 2 A guard, sentinel. — nyaṃ An army, a troop; sa pratasthe'rināśāya harisainyairanudrutaḥ R. 12. 67.
